sections.heading: 1. Set up first
lines: ① Put shampoo and towels within reach.
② Kneel on a folded towel by the tub.
③ Turn with your feet, not by twisting.
④ Every 5 min, stand and lean back gently ×5.

sections.heading: 2. Stop if…
lines: Pain spreads into your leg, or your
leg feels numb — stop and get advice.

caption:
Toto bathes the dog every weekend, and the back often grumbles afterwards. Long spells bent over the tub can do that.

Bending and twisting for a while makes the back work harder and tire quickly. Set shampoo and towels within reach first, kneel on a folded towel, keep the dog close, and turn with your feet instead of twisting. Every five minutes, stand up and gently lean back five times.

Pain spreading down a leg, numbness, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐶
